say:4:1520703002:1.text: Young Qin! The great Herdmaster is here! Stop crying!
say:4:1520703002:1.source_cn: 奇！伟大的狩猎神来了，不许再哭哭啼啼的！
say:4:1520703002:1.male: Young Qin! The great Herdmaster is here! Stop crying!
say:4:1520703002:1.female: Young Qin! The great Herdmaster is here! Stop crying!

say:5:1520703003:1.text: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...
say:5:1520703003:1.source_cn: 狩……狩猎神大人……能不能不要烧死我的咚咚？呜呜呜……
say:5:1520703003:1.male: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...
say:5:1520703003:1.female: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...

choice_prompt:6:1520703003.text: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...
choice_prompt:6:1520703003.source_cn: 狩……狩猎神大人……能不能不要烧死我的咚咚？呜呜呜……
choice_prompt:6:1520703003.male: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...
choice_prompt:6:1520703003.female: G-Great Herdmaster... c-could you please not burn my Bonbon? Please...

say:7:1520703004:1.text: Bonbon... he's my best friend. He's a <style="highlight">gleamtail</style>...
say:7:1520703004:1.source_cn: 咚咚……它是我的好朋友，一只<style=highli...
say:7:1520703004:1.male: Bonbon... he's my best friend. He's a <style="highlight">gleamtail</style>...
say:7:1520703004:1.female: Bonbon... he's my best friend. He's a <style="highlight">gleamtail</style>...

say:8:1520703005:1.text: Nonsense! That thing is an offering to the Herdmaster!
say:8:1520703005:1.source_cn: 不许胡说！什么朋友，那是献给兽群之主的祭品！
say:8:1520703005:1.male: Nonsense! That thing is an offering to the Herdmaster!
say:8:1520703005:1.female: Nonsense! That thing is an offering to the Herdmaster!

say:9:1520703006:1.text: I told you, every creature in the jungles and swamps belongs to the <male>Hunting God</male>. To be chosen as an offering... that's the highest honor!
say:9:1520703006:1.source_cn: 阿爹早就告诉过你，丛林和沼泽里的所有生命都是狩猎神的子...
say:9:1520703006:1.male: I told you, every creature in the jungles and swamps belongs to the <male>Hunting God</male>. To be chosen as an offering... that's the highest honor!
say:9:1520703006:1.female: I told you, every creature in the jungles and swamps belongs to the <female>Hunting Goddess</female>. To be chosen as an offering... that's the highest honor!

say:10:1520703007:1.text: Look at Gala... no, the emissary. She was once offered as a sacrifice too. Now she stands above even Modra!
say:10:1520703007:1.source_cn: 你看加拉……不，神使。神使也曾经是狩猎神的祭品，她现在...

say:11:1520703008:1.text: Yes. I was offered to the Herdmaster as a child.
say:11:1520703008:1.source_cn: 是。加拉从小就是狩猎神的祭品。
say:11:1520703008:1.male: Yes. I was offered to the Herdmaster as a child.
say:11:1520703008:1.female: Yes. I was offered to the Herdmaster as a child.

say:12:1520703009:1.text: To die for the Herdmaster was my greatest honor.
say:12:1520703009:1.source_cn: 为狩猎神而死，是加拉的荣幸。
say:12:1520703009:1.male: To die for the Herdmaster was my greatest honor.
say:12:1520703009:1.female: To die for the Herdmaster was my greatest honor.

say:13:1520703010:1.text: But... but Bonbon's just a gleamtail! He wouldn't feel honored, not even a little!
say:13:1520703010:1.source_cn: 可是……可是咚咚只是一只幻鼠！它才不会感到荣幸——！

say:19:1520703013:1.text: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting God! It's my fault! I spoiled him...
say:19:1520703013:1.source_cn: 对不起……请狩猎神大人恕罪！都是我宠坏了奇……
say:19:1520703013:1.male: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting God! It's my fault! I spoiled him...
say:19:1520703013:1.female: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting Goddess! It's my fault! I spoiled him...

choice_prompt:20:1520703013.text: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting God! It's my fault! I spoiled him...
choice_prompt:20:1520703013.source_cn: 对不起……请狩猎神大人恕罪！都是我宠坏了奇……
choice_prompt:20:1520703013.male: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting God! It's my fault! I spoiled him...
choice_prompt:20:1520703013.female: I'm sorry... please forgive him, great Hunting Goddess! It's my fault! I spoiled him...

say:21:1520703014:1.text: The Hunting God is merciful. You should be grateful.
say:21:1520703014:1.source_cn: 狩猎神大人很仁慈，你应该感恩。
say:21:1520703014:1.male: The Hunting God is merciful. You should be grateful.
say:21:1520703014:1.female: The Hunting Goddess is merciful. You should be grateful.

say:22:1520703015:1.text: Of course! I'll never forget it!
say:22:1520703015:1.source_cn: 当然！我会永远铭记在心的！
say:22:1520703015:1.male: Of course! I'll never forget it!
say:22:1520703015:1.female: Of course! I'll never forget it!

say:23:1520703018:1.text: If it pleases you, great Hunting God... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?
say:23:1520703018:1.source_cn: 如果狩猎神大人不介意，也请去<style=highli...
say:23:1520703018:1.male: If it pleases you, great Hunting God... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?
say:23:1520703018:1.female: If it pleases you, great Hunting Goddess... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?

choice_prompt:24:1520703018.text: If it pleases you, great Hunting God... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?
choice_prompt:24:1520703018.source_cn: 如果狩猎神大人不介意，也请去<style=highlight>看看祭品</style>是否满意吧。
choice_prompt:24:1520703018.male: If it pleases you, great Hunting God... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?
choice_prompt:24:1520703018.female: If it pleases you, great Hunting Goddess... perhaps you would honor us by <style="highlight">inspecting the offerings</style>?

choice:24:0:1.text: Sure, I'd like to meet Bonbon.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 正好我也想认识一下咚咚
choice:24:0:1.male: Sure, I'd like to meet Bonbon.
choice:24:0:1.female: Sure, I'd like to meet Bonbon.

choice:20:0:1.text: It's okay. He's just a child.
choice:20:0:1.male: It's okay. He's just a child.
choice:20:0:1.female: It's okay. He's just a child.

say:27:1520703016:1.text: No need. Wrathwood Grove's exits are all guarded. He won't get far.
say:27:1520703016:1.source_cn: 不。树怒山谷的几个出口都有守卫，他不会跑出去的。
say:27:1520703016:1.male: No need. Wrathwood Grove's exits are all guarded. He won't get far.
say:27:1520703016:1.female: No need. Wrathwood Grove's exits are all guarded. He won't get far.

say:28:1520703017:1.text: Please, give him some time. I promise, he'll come around!
say:28:1520703017:1.source_cn: 请给他一点时间……我可以保证，他一定会想清楚的！
say:28:1520703017:1.male: Please, give him some time. I promise, he'll come around!
say:28:1520703017:1.female: Please, give him some time. I promise, he'll come around!
